description: Illustrative sentences grouped into semantic clusters. Within a cluster, sentences are paraphrases that mean nearly the same thing; across clusters they are unrelated. This is exactly the structure a semantic cache exploits: a new query that paraphrases a previous one should land near it in vector space and score a cache hit.

sentences.text: How do I get a refund for my order?
What's the process to return an item and get my money back?
Can I be reimbursed for a purchase I already paid for?
I forgot my password and can't log in.
How do I reset my account password?
The login page won't accept my credentials — how do I recover access?
How long does delivery usually take?
What is the estimated shipping time for my order?
It looks like it's going to rain this afternoon.
This restaurant makes the best wood-fired pizza in town.
The function throws a null pointer exception on line 42.
The telescope captured a stunning image of a distant galaxy.
